title: complete-lattice
description: A lattice in which every subset, not only every pair, has a meet and a join — including the empty and the infinite. The setting Knaster–Tarski needs; the value structure settling ascends.

arbitrary-meets.description: every subset S has a meet ⋀S (greatest lower bound of all of S)

arbitrary-joins.description: every subset S has a join ⋁S (least upper bound of all of S); each half forces the other
